description.ncbi_summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of vasculature development involved in avascular cornea development in camera-type eye and regulation of extracellular matrix organization. Located in extracellular region. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Has a role in the formation and organization of the extracellular matrix. In the eye, it functions as a mediator of dexamethasone-induced matrix deposition in the trabecular meshwork, the tissue responsible for the outflow of the ocular aqueous humor and for the maintenance of intraocular pressure (PubMed:21199193). Is a negative regulator of angiogenesis in the cornea, and plays a major role in maintaining corneal avascularity and transparency (PubMed:25622036).
